preRules.note: A noncharacter U+FDD0-U+FDDF in the text is not one of the tables' marks: U+FFFD, passed through and reported.

Assamese ৰ is র in these fonts: one code, B9, draws র in a Bangla font and ৰ in an Assamese one, and the reph and the ra-phala are the same glyphs for both. Assamese Unicode spells ra ৰ, so ৰ্ক is the reph on ক (কৰ্ম = কর্ম) and প্ৰ the ra-phala (= প্র), never ৰ with a visible hasanta.
ড + nukta is ড় (normalised text keeps them apart).
ঢ + nukta is ঢ়.
য + nukta is য়.
ASCII " that opens a quote (at the start, after a space, a bracket or a dash) is “ (91 91): byte 22 draws অ.
Any other ASCII " closes a quote: ” (92 92).
ASCII ' that opens a quote is ‘ (91): byte 27 draws ঐ.
Any other ASCII ' (a closing quote, an apostrophe) is ’ (92).
C্র্র: C with a visible hasanta, then র with its own ra-phala F8 (ক্র্র = 41 F4 A1 B9 F8, as Shree's composer writes ক্ৰ্র). Not after র: র্র্র is the reph on র্র.
C্র্ with no letter after it: C with a visible hasanta, then র with one (ক্র্ = 41 F4 A1 B9 F4, as the composer writes ক্ৰ্).
ো is ে ... া: split, so the ে can go first.
ৌ is ে ... ৗ: split, so the ে can go first.
র + ZWJ + ্য (ra with the ya-phala) is written as the composer writes র‌্য.
Reph: র্ before a letter (or vowel) is written after that letter, its cluster and its signs (U+FDD0 marks it for the pairs).
র্ that no letter follows (the end of a word): ra with a visible hasanta, B9 F4 - never the reph A2, which waits for its letter.
Reph on a letter with a sign and ঁ: the reph before the ঁ (with the bare letter, ি ী or ৗ the ঁ comes first).
ি + ঁ: one glyph 7B before the cluster (U+FDD3 marks it).
Pre-base signs ি ে ৈ: written before the cluster (Unicode logical order -> legacy visual order).
ৈ on no letter: ED (U+FDD5 marks it); before a letter (moved there) it is EE.
Nukta: the dot is written before its letter.
Ya-phala: B8 after the letter and its spacer (U+FDD2 marks it).
Ra-phala (U+FDD4 marks it): F6 after a conjunct; a letter of its own has its own glyph in the pairs.

postRules.note: Signs below a letter, ঁ, the reph and the hasanta go before its spacer (A1, or FE after ষ্ক স্ক).
ু under a subscript ্ন ্ব or the ra-phala F6/F9: E6.
ূ under a subscript ্ন ্ব or the ra-phala F6/F9: E9.
Reph on a letter with ং/ঃ: before the spacer, the sign after it.
U+FDD1 in a pair keeps the rules above off a spelling the composer writes its own way; it is not text.
